Usage:
  release [flags]
  release [command]

Available Commands:
  changelog   Assemble, author and render the changelog section a release would carry
  config      Answer with the effective configuration and validate it
  cut         Cut a release as a stage branch and open its pull request
  help        Help about any command
  version     Resolve the version a release would carry, without writing anything

Flags:
      --config file   Use this configuration file instead of discovering one
  -h, --help          help for release
  -C, --repo path     Operate on the repository at this path instead of the working directory
  -V, --version       Print the tool's own version

Use "release [command] --help" for more information about a command.
